rows.take_2_defect: At 2.0-2.5 s the left gentleman hands the brown tied bundle to the top-hatted gentleman, who already carries a light ribbon-tied parcel under his left arm. At 3.0-5.5 s (inside the used 0.00-5.36 s) the light parcel merges into one shrinking brown bundle; at 6.0-7.0 s the light parcel is back and the brown bundle is gone (acting Chief, J3747).
rows.root_cause: The take-1 start still already shows two bulky separate bundles (one under an arm, one thick stack on the step). With one carrier on the steps, the model dissolves one of them.
rows.fix: Fresh start still with exactly one tied bundle, already in one gentleman's hands. No hand-off, nothing put down, nothing on the steps. The other gentleman walks beside him with empty hands.

rows.take_2_defect: Bright golden light comes out of the inside of the green book at 0.0-2.0 s (inside the used 0.00-4.96 s), against the no-glow rule. The front cover is jaggedly cracked across the middle (0.0-2.0 s) and morphs flat into green pages (2.5-3.5 s). The folded letter curls into the air and flips itself (4.0-4.5 s) (acting Chief, J3747).
rows.root_cause: The take-1 start still itself has the cracked green cover and a warm yellow-orange light inside the open pages, so any clip started from it fails at 0.0 s.
rows.fix: Mandatory fresh start still: the book closed, whole and flat, lit only by cool grey window light, so there is no open gutter for light to come from at frame 0. In the clip one hand lays the cover open; the letter and the spectacles do not move.
